courses.title: Yoga Nidra Training Program
courses.description: Group or one-to-one sessions in Yoga Nidra, the yogic relaxation practice, at the Integral Yoga Institute in Coimbatore. The practice is taught as a way to let go of mental, emotional and muscular tension and rest deeply.

left_out: Yoga for Special Child teacher training (Sonia Sumar method): no cure claim, but it trains teachers to evaluate children and 'work with specific syndromes and disorders'; therapy-led (scope rule), and the page gives no current dates ('conducted once annually').
Healthy Heart, Yoga Therapy and Counselling, Prenatal/Postnatal: no longer linked from the site's menus on 12 Nov 2026; not found.
Blog posts on sleep and stress relief: on reading, the sleep post is a general promotion of the institute's classes rather than a practice, and the stress post is an article; not free resources.
